problems.problem:
Milkdromeda II (80 points)

In this problem we follow up on the home round and continue with one of the most distant objects visible to the naked eye. The Andromeda Galaxy (M 31) is currently at a distance $d_0 = 2.537$ Mly from the Earth and has a total apparent magnitude $m_0 = 3.44$ mag. On the sky, however, it appears less bright, since it is an extended source of light. Its nucleus has a surface magnitude $\mu_0 = 17\ \mathrm{mag/arcsec^2}$.

(a) [40 points] The galaxy M 31 is gradually approaching the Milky Way and in about 3 billion years it will be at a distance $d = 200$ kpc. What apparent magnitude $m$ and what surface magnitude of the nucleus $\mu$ shall we observe at that time?

In the home round you found that the observed wavelength of the $\mathrm{H\alpha}$ spectral line of the galaxy M 31 is currently $\lambda_0 = 655.62$ nm, while the laboratory wavelength of this line is $\lambda_{\mathrm{lab}} = 656.28$ nm. The shift of the spectrum is the result of a combination of the proper velocity of M 31 and the expansion of the Universe.

(b) [40 points] At what wavelength $\lambda$ shall we observe the $\mathrm{H\alpha}$ spectral line of the galaxy M 31 in the future, at the time when it is at the distance $d = 200$ kpc? At that time, according to the standard cosmological model, the value of the Hubble constant will be 90 % of today's value. Neglect the gravitational interaction of the galaxy M 31 and the Milky Way.

Throughout the problem we keep the classical cosmological notation, in which the subscript 0 denotes quantities referring to the present and quantities without a subscript refer to the future.
problems.problem_orig:
Milkdroméda II (80 b)

V tejto úlohe nadviažeme na domáce kolo a budeme sa ďalej zaoberať jedným z najvzdialenejších objektov viditeľných voľným okom. Galaxia v Androméde (M 31) sa v súčasnosti nachádza vo vzdialenosti $d_0 = 2{,}537$ Mly od Zeme a má celkovú zdanlivú magnitúdu $m_0 = 3{,}44$ mag. Na oblohe sa však javí ako menej jasná, keďže ide o plošný zdroj svetla. Jej jadro má plošnú magnitúdu $\mu_0 = 17\ \mathrm{mag/arcsec^2}$.

(a) [40 b] Galaxia M 31 sa postupne približuje k Mliečnej ceste a o približne 3 miliardy rokov sa bude nachádzať vo vzdialenosti $d = 200$ kpc. Akú budeme pozorovať jej zdanlivú magnitúdu $m$ a plošnú magnitúdu jadra $\mu$ v tejto dobe?

V domácom kole ste zistili, že pozorovaná vlnová dĺžka spektrálnej čiary $\mathrm{H\alpha}$ galaxie M 31 je v súčasnosti $\lambda_0 = 655{,}62$ nm, pričom laboratórna vlnová dĺžka tejto čiary je $\lambda_{\mathrm{lab}} = 656{,}28$ nm. Posun spektra je výsledkom kombinácie vlastnej rýchlosti M 31 a rozpínania vesmíru.

(b) [40 b] Na akej vlnovej dĺžke $\lambda$ budeme pozorovať spektrálnu čiaru $\mathrm{H\alpha}$ galaxie M 31 v budúcnosti v čase, keď bude vo vzdialenosti $d = 200$ kpc? V tejto dobe bude na základe štandardného kozmologického modelu hodnota Hubblovej konštanty rovná 90 % dnešnej hodnoty. Zanedbajte gravitačnú interakciu galaxie M 31 a Mliečnej cesty.

V celej úlohe sa budeme držať klasického kozmologického značenia, v ktorom budeme dolným indexom 0 označovať veličiny vztiahnuté na súčasnosť a bez indexu budeme označovať veličiny vztiahnuté na budúcnosť.

problems.problem:
Night snack (80 points)

Is it possible to cook a pot of rice at the focus of the Nordic Optical Telescope (NOT) if we point it at the full Moon? The Estonian astronomer Anni pondered such philosophical questions during long nights at the observatory. In this problem you will turn this philosophical question into a physical one and try to find out whether astronomers really can prepare dinner in the telescope in an emergency.

Solve the following series of tasks, which will lead you to the desired answer:

(a) [15 points] Compute the flux from the full Moon reaching the top of the Earth's atmosphere in the V filter. You may take the brightnesses of objects in this filter to be the same as the corresponding visual brightnesses. The flux from the Sun reaching the Earth's atmosphere in the V filter is $F_\odot = 1240\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$.

(b) [20 points] Because light passes through the Earth's atmosphere, the light of objects is attenuated. The thicker the layer of atmosphere the light passes through, the more it is attenuated. For this reason we choose for cooking the rice a night when the Moon is in the position closest possible to the zenith. Compute the minimum possible zenith distance of the Moon from the point of view of an observer in the NOT building.

(c) [15 points] Because of the passage through the atmosphere the magnitude of an object on the sky increases by
$$\Delta m = \frac{k}{\cos z}\,, \qquad \text{(T2.1)}$$
where $k = 0.2$ is the extinction coefficient and $z$ is the zenith distance. Compute the radiation flux of the Moon that, after passing through the atmosphere, falls on the surface of the telescope.

(d) [15 points] Compute what power the Nordic Optical Telescope can concentrate into its focus, assuming that 12 % of the light is lost in reflections. Assume that the telescope works in the V filter and that light of other wavelengths does not reach the focus.

(e) [10 points] You will try to cook the rice in one litre of water with an initial temperature of $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Determine the energy needed to heat the water to the boiling point, which at the altitude of NOT is about $92\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. The specific heat capacity of water is $c_{\mathrm{H_2O}} = 4180\ \mathrm{J\,kg^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$.

(f) [5 points] Find in what time the water at the focus heats up enough to start boiling. Decide whether it is realistic to manage to heat the water to the required temperature within one night. For simplicity you may neglect the motion of the Moon on the sky and assume that it stays near the zenith the whole time (this is a very bold assumption, but it is quite sufficient for our simple estimate).

The following information about NOT may be useful in the calculation:
- diameter of the primary mirror: $D = 2.56$ m,
- focal length of the primary mirror: $f = 28.160$ m,
- latitude: $\varphi = 28^\circ 45'$ N,
- longitude: $\lambda = 17^\circ 53'$ W,
- altitude: $H = 2382$ m.
problems.problem_orig:
Nočný snack (80 b)

Je možné uvariť hrniec ryže v ohnisku Nordic Optical Telescope (NOT), ak ho namierime na Mesiac v splne? Aj nad takýmito filozofickými otázkami sa zamýšľala estónska astronómka Anni počas dlhých nocí na observatóriu. V tomto príklade z tejto filozofickej otázky spravíte fyzikálnu a pokúsite sa zistiť, či si astronómovia naozaj v prípade núdze môžu v ďalekohľade pripraviť večeru.

Vyriešte nasledujúcu sériu podúloh, ktorá vás privedie k vytúženej odpovedi:

(a) [15 b] Vypočítajte, aký tok dopadá z Mesiaca v splne na vrchol zemskej atmosféry vo V filtri. Jasnosti objektov v tomto filtri môžete považovať za rovnaké, aké zodpovedajú vizuálnej jasnosti. Zo Slnka dopadá na zemskú atmosféru vo V filtri tok $F_\odot = 1240\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$.

(b) [20 b] Kvôli prechodu svetla zemskou atmosférou sa zoslabuje svetlo objektov. Čím hrubšou vrstvou atmosféry svetlo prechádza, tým viac sa zoslabí. Z toho dôvodu si na varenie ryže vyberieme noc, kedy sa Mesiac nachádza v najbližšej možnej polohe k zenitu. Vypočítajte minimálnu možnú zenitovú vzdialenosť Mesiaca z pohľadu pozorovateľa nachádzajúceho sa v budove NOT.

(c) [15 b] Magnitúda objektu na oblohe sa kvôli prechodu cez atmosféru zvýši o
$$\Delta m = \frac{k}{\cos z}\,, \qquad \text{(T2.1)}$$
kde $k = 0{,}2$ je koeficient extinkcie a $z$ je zenitová vzdialenosť. Vypočítajte tok žiarenia Mesiaca, ktorý po prechode atmosférou dopadá na povrch ďalekohľadu.

(d) [15 b] Vypočítajte, aký výkon dokáže Nordic Optical Telescope sústrediť do svojho ohniska za predpokladu, že sa 12 % svetla stratí pri odrazoch. Predpokladajte, že ďalekohľad pracuje vo V filtri a svetlo iných vlnových dĺžok sa do ohniska nedostane.

(e) [10 b] Ryžu skúsite uvariť v jednom litri vody s počiatočnou teplotou $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Určte energiu potrebnú na zohriatie vody na teplotu varu, ktorá je v nadmorskej výške NOT asi $92\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Hmotnostná tepelná kapacita vody je $c_{\mathrm{H_2O}} = 4180\ \mathrm{J\,kg^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$.

(f) [5 b] Zistite, za akú dobu sa voda v ohnisku zohreje dostatočne na to, aby začala vrieť. Rozhodnite, či je realistické stihnúť vodu zohriať na požadovanú teplotu v priebehu jednej noci. Pre jednoduchosť môžete zanedbať pohyb Mesiaca po oblohe a predpokladajte, že zostane celú dobu v blízkosti zenitu (je to síce veľmi odvážny predpoklad, ale pre náš jednoduchý odhad nám bohate stačí).

Pri výpočte môžu byť užitočné nasledujúce informácie o NOT:
- priemer primárneho zrkadla: $D = 2{,}56$ m,
- ohnisková vzdialenosť primárneho zrkadla: $f = 28{,}160$ m,
- zemepisná šírka: $\varphi = 28^\circ 45'$ N,
- zemepisná dĺžka: $\lambda = 17^\circ 53'$ W,
- nadmorská výška: $H = 2382$ m.

problems.problem:
Celebrating the landing on Mars (110 points)

It is the year 2230. Humanity has successfully settled Mars and is celebrating the two-hundredth anniversary of the landing of the first human on its surface. To celebrate this amazing scientific milestone, politicians on the Earth decided to prepare a surprise for the inhabitants of Mars: a special gift, which will be delivered to them by a rocket launched from the Earth. Throughout the problem consider only the gravitational influence of the Sun (i.e. neglect the gravitational influence of the planets) and also consider the trajectories of the Earth and Mars to be circular.

(a) [14 points] How often does a favourable opportunity for a flight to Mars arise from the Earth? In other words, compute the synodic period between two successive oppositions of Mars.

(b) [12 points] What is the shortest $\tau_{\min}$ and the longest $\tau_{\max}$ response time (so-called latency, popularly called "ping") in the transmission of information between the Earth and Mars? We define it as the time in which, after sending a message, we receive a reply. Assume that the information is transmitted by electromagnetic waves in vacuum at the speed of light.

So that the action stays secret, however, the rocket officially poses as an "ordinary" scientific mission intended for deep-space exploration. In reality, though, it releases a commemorative package near Mars.

(c) [10 points] Compute the minimum speed of the rocket $v_{\mathrm{p}}$ needed for it to get from the distance $r_{\mathrm{p}} = 1$ au from the Sun to infinity.

(d) [12 points] Determine the orbital speed of the Earth $v_\oplus$. By what speed $v_\Delta$ must the rocket accelerate if it fully uses the orbital speed of the Earth? We remind you that the gravitational influence of the Earth is neglected.

The rocket will move along a parabolic trajectory, for which Barker's equation in the list of constants holds. It is the dependence of the time $t$ on the true anomaly $\nu$, where $t_0$ is the time of pericentre passage. The parameter $p$ is the so-called semi-latus rectum, which you can determine using its geometrical meaning in Figure T3.1 or using its expression in terms of the angular momentum $L$, which you will also find in the list of constants. The general equation of a conic section in polar coordinates (distance $r$, true anomaly $\nu$) may also be useful.

(e) [40 points] Rearrange the polar equation of a conic section from the list of constants so that the distance $r$ is expressed only in terms of $r_{\mathrm{p}}$, $\nu$ and basic physical constants. Similarly rearrange Barker's equation for a parabola so that the time $t - t_0$ is expressed only in terms of $\nu$, the sidereal period of the Earth $P_\oplus$ and basic physical constants.

(f) [22 points] Compute after how many days from the launch on the Earth the rocket crosses the orbit of Mars.

From the list of constants: polar equation of a conic section $r = \frac{p}{1 + e\cos\vartheta}$, $p = \frac{L^2}{GMm^2} = a(1 - e^2)$; Barker's equation for a parabola $t - t_0 = \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{p^3}{GM}}\left(\tan\frac{\nu}{2} + \frac{1}{3}\tan^3\frac{\nu}{2}\right)$.

Figure T3.1: Scheme of a parabolic trajectory with its focus at the Sun and pericentre $r_{\mathrm{P}} = 1$ au. The black dot shows the rocket at a distance $r$ from the Sun with true anomaly $\nu$.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/astronomy-olympiads-bank/main/images/sk-2026-rk-t3-1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Oslava pristátia na Marse (110 b)

Píše sa rok 2230. Ľudstvo úspešne osídlilo Mars a oslavuje dvojsté výročie pristátia prvého človeka na jeho povrchu. Na oslavu tohto úžasného vedeckého míľnika sa politici na Zemi rozhodli pripraviť pre obyvateľov Marsu prekvapenie – špeciálny dar, ktorý im doručí raketa vyslaná zo Zeme. V celej úlohe uvažujte iba gravitačný vplyv Slnka (teda zanedbajte gravitačný vplyv planét) a takisto uvažujte kruhové trajektórie Zeme a Marsu.

(a) [14 b] Ako často sa zo Zeme naskytá výhodná príležitosť letu na Mars? Inými slovami, vypočítajte synodickú obežnú dobu medzi dvomi po sebe idúcimi opozíciami Marsu.

(b) [12 b] Aká je najkratšia $\tau_{\min}$ a aká je najdlhšia $\tau_{\max}$ doba odozvy (tzv. latencia, ľudovo nazývaná „ping“) pri prenose informácie medzi Zemou a Marsom? Definujeme ju ako čas, za ktorý sa nám po odoslaní správy vráti odpoveď. Predpokladajte, že sa informácia prenáša prostredníctvom elektromagnetických vĺn vo vákuu rýchlosťou svetla.

Aby však akcia zostala v tajnosti, oficiálne sa raketa tvári ako „obyčajná“ vedecká misia určená na prieskum hlbokého vesmíru. V skutočnosti však pri Marse vypustí pamätný balík.

(c) [10 b] Vypočítajte najmenšiu rýchlosť rakety $v_{\mathrm{p}}$ potrebnú na to, aby sa dostala zo vzdialenosti $r_{\mathrm{p}} = 1$ au od Slnka do nekonečna.

(d) [12 b] Určte obežnú rýchlosť Zeme $v_\oplus$. O akú rýchlosť $v_\Delta$ musí raketa zrýchliť, ak úplne využije obežnú rýchlosť Zeme? Pripomíname zanedbanie gravitačného vplyvu Zeme.

Raketa sa bude pohybovať po parabolickej trajektórii, pre ktorú platí Barkerova rovnica v konštantovníku. Ide o závislosť času $t$ od pravej anomálie $\nu$, pričom $t_0$ predstavuje čas prechodu pericentrom. Parameter $p$ je takzvaný semi-latus rectum, ktorý viete určiť pomocou jeho geometrického významu na obrázku T3.1 alebo pomocou jeho vyjadrenia cez moment hybnosti $L$, ktoré takisto nájdete v konštantovníku. Takisto sa vám môže hodiť všeobecná rovnica kužeľosečky v polárnych súradniciach (vzdialenosť $r$, pravá anomália $\nu$).

(e) [40 b] Upravte polárnu rovnicu kužeľosečky z konštantovníka tak, aby bola vzdialenosť $r$ vyjadrená iba pomocou $r_{\mathrm{p}}$, $\nu$ a základných fyzikálnych konštánt. Obdobne upravte Barkerovu rovnicu pre parabolu tak, aby bol čas $t - t_0$ vyjadrený iba pomocou $\nu$, siderickej periódy Zeme $P_\oplus$ a základných fyzikálnych konštánt.

(f) [22 b] Vypočítajte, za koľko dní od štartu na Zemi pretne raketa orbitu Marsu.

Z konštantovníka: polárna rovnica kužeľosečky $r = \frac{p}{1 + e\cos\vartheta}$, $p = \frac{L^2}{GMm^2} = a(1 - e^2)$; Barkerova rovnica pre parabolu $t - t_0 = \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{p^3}{GM}}\left(\tan\frac{\nu}{2} + \frac{1}{3}\tan^3\frac{\nu}{2}\right)$.

Obr. T3.1: Schéma parabolickej dráhy s ohniskom v Slnku a pericentrom $r_{\mathrm{P}} = 1$ au. Čiernou bodkou je znázornená raketa vo vzdialenosti $r$ od Slnka s pravou anomáliou $\nu$.

problems.problem:
17. listopad (130 points)

Rado and Terka are simultaneously observing the full Moon from the windows of their student residence, Koleje 17. listopadu. It is the 22nd tallest building in Prague, as high as 69 m. It has 22 storeys including the ground floor and the secret mythical floor. All storeys are equally high and directly above the highest one there is the roof. The Moon rises exactly at the cardinal point east above the nearby hill Bílá skála, at a horizontal distance of 900 m from Koleje 17. listopadu.

Rado lives on the top floor; his eyes are at the same altitude as the top of Bílá skála, and he sees the lower edge of the Moon just touching this top. Because of the different atmospheric refraction (at different heights above the horizon) the Moon is flattened by $5'$ in the vertical direction, see Figure T4.1. The value of the atmospheric refraction at the horizon is $35'$. The reddish colour of the Moon is caused by Rayleigh scattering in the atmosphere, an effect that causes stronger scattering of blue light than of red light.

Terka is 158 cm tall, sees the Moon equally flattened, and lives in a room one floor lower than Rado, who is 188 cm tall. For both of them their eyes are at nine tenths of their body height. The geographical coordinates of Prague are $50^\circ$ N and $14.5^\circ$ E.

Figure T4.1: The apparent position of the horizon formed by the hill Bílá skála relative to the position of the Moon on the sky. [The figure is not reproduced here; it is on page 12 of the official file: https://www.astronomickaolympiada.sk/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/AO2026-RK-SS-vzoraky.pdf]

Tasks

(a) [40 points] Draw into Figure T4.1 the horizon that Terka apparently sees, with a precision of $1'$.

(b) [20 points] Determine the declination of the Moon, with a precision of $1^\circ$.

(c) [10 points] Determine the hour angle of the Moon, with a precision of $0.1^{\mathrm{h}}$.

(d) [20 points] Determine the local apparent solar time, with a precision of 1 hour.

(e) [40 points] Determine how long the Moon was rising above Rado's horizon, with a precision of 0.1 min.
problems.problem_orig:
17. listopad (130 b)

Rado a Terka súčasne pozorujú spln Mesiaca z okien internátu, Koleje 17. listopadu. Ide o 22. najvyššiu budovu v Prahe, s výškou až 69 m. Má 22 podlaží vrátane prízemia a tajného mýtického poschodia. Všetky podlažia sú rovnako vysoké a nad tým najvyšším je hneď strecha. Mesiac vychádza presne na svetovej strane východ nad neďaleký kopec Bílá skála v horizontálnej vzdialenosti 900 m od Koleje 17. listopadu.

Rado býva na najvyššom podlaží, jeho oči sa nachádzajú v rovnakej nadmorskej výške ako vrchol Bílej skály a vidia, ako sa spodný okraj Mesiaca práve dotýka tohto vrcholu. Mesiac je kvôli rozdielnej atmosférickej refrakcii (v rôznych výškach nad horizontom) sploštený o $5'$ vo vertikálnom smere, viď. obrázok T4.1. Hodnota atmosférickej refrakcie na horizonte je $35'$. Červenkastá farba Mesiaca je spôsobená Rayleighovým rozptylom v atmosfére, čo je efekt spôsobujúci silnejší rozptyl modrého svetla voči červenému.

Terka meria 158 cm, pozoruje Mesiac rovnako sploštený a býva na izbe o jedno poschodie nižšie ako Rado, ktorý meria 188 cm. Pre oboch platí, že sa ich oči nachádzajú v deviatich desatinách tela. Zemepisné súradnice Prahy sú $50^\circ$ N a $14{,}5^\circ$ E.

Obr. T4.1: Zdanlivá poloha obzoru vytvoreného kopcom Bílá Skála vzhľadom na polohu Mesiaca na oblohe. [Obrázok sa tu nereprodukuje; nachádza sa na strane 12 oficiálneho súboru: https://www.astronomickaolympiada.sk/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/AO2026-RK-SS-vzoraky.pdf]

Úlohy

(a) [40 b] Do obrázku T4.1 zakreslite obzor, ktorý zdanlivo vidí Terka, s presnosťou na $1'$.

(b) [20 b] Určte deklináciu Mesiaca, s presnosťou na $1^\circ$.

(c) [10 b] Určte hodinový uhol Mesiaca, s presnosťou na $0{,}1^{\mathrm{h}}$.

(d) [20 b] Určte miestny pravý slnečný čas, s presnosťou na 1 hodinu.

(e) [40 b] Určte, ako dlho vychádzal Mesiac nad Radov obzor, s presnosťou na 0,1 min.

problems.problem:
Solar (200 points)

As the distribution of the Sun's magnetic field changes, its surface activity changes; the best-known manifestation of this is the occurrence of sunspots. Their activity in time is described by the so-called butterfly diagram, shown in the attached graph. In the problem assume that the Sun is a perfect sphere.

(a) [50 points] Estimate the years in which solar minima occurred and summarise them in a clear table. Give the serial number of each minimum in the diagram, counting from left to right. Start with the minimum of the first complete recorded solar cycle.

(b) [70 points] Plot the values from the table you made in part (a) in a graph of the year of the minimum against its serial number.

(c) [50 points] Fit a straight line to the graph of part (b) and on the basis of the fit determine the slope of this line. This value is called the Schwabe solar cycle.

(d) [30 points] From the butterfly diagram determine the range of heliographic latitudes at which sunspots occurred from 1870 to 2020.

Figure D1.1: Butterfly diagram, i.e. heliographic latitude as a function of time. You may notice that at the beginning of a cycle sunspots are visible farther from the solar equator and gradually move closer to the equator, graphically forming a shape similar to the wings of a butterfly. The colours in the diagram show the abundance of sunspots, the densest occurrence being shown in black. Source: Royal Observatory, Greenwich, NOAA.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/astronomy-olympiads-bank/main/images/sk-2026-rk-d1-1.png

(b) [70 b] Vyneste hodnoty z tabuľky, ktorú ste vyrobili v podzadaní (a), do grafu závislosti roku minima od jeho poradového čísla.

(c) [50 b] Graf z podúlohy (b) preložte priamkou a na základe fitu určte smernicu danej priamky. Táto hodnota sa nazýva Schwabeho slnečný cyklus.

problems.problem:
Space Odyssey (20 points)

A frequent motif in science-fiction literature and films is interstellar travel with the need for artificial gravity in the spacecraft. A simple way to create artificial gravity is a rotating cylinder. We could have met a spaceship of such a shape in the books or films Space Odyssey, The Martian, Rendezvous with Rama or Passengers.

The acceleration is produced by the rotation of the cylinder about its axis. The problem is not to achieve the acceleration itself, but unpleasantness could arise from a large difference between the accelerations acting on a person's head and feet. Compute what radius $R$ the cylinder must have so that for all astronauts the acceleration acting on the feet is at most $p = 5\,\%$ larger than the acceleration acting on the head. The height of the astronauts $h$ ranges from 1.5 m to 2 m, and the floor of the ship is directly on the inner shell of the cylinder.

Figure T1.1: Scheme of the ship.

problems.problem_orig:
Vesmírna Odysea (20 b)

Častým motívom v sci-fi literatúre a filmoch je medzihviezdne cestovanie s potrebou umelej gravitácie v kozmickej lodi. Jednoduchým spôsobom, ako vytvoriť umelú gravitáciu, je rotujúci valec. S vesmírnou loďou takéhoto tvaru sme sa mohli stretnúť v knihách, resp. filmoch Vesmírna odysea, Marťan, Stretnutie s Rámom alebo Pasažieri.

Zrýchlenie je vytvárané rotáciou valca okolo jeho osi. Problémom nie je dosiahnuť samotné zrýchlenie, ale nepríjemnosti by mohli vzniknúť pri veľkom rozdiele zrýchlení pôsobiacich na hlavu a na nohy človeka. Vypočítajte, aký polomer $R$ musí mať valec, aby pre všetkých astronautov bolo zrýchlenie pôsobiace na nohy maximálne o $p = 5\,\%$ väčšie ako zrýchlenie pôsobiace na hlavu. Výška astronautov $h$ sa pohybuje v rozmedzí 1,5 m až 2 m a podlaha lode sa nachádza priamo na vnútornom plášti valca.

problems.problem:
The short life of a particle (20 points)

The interaction with cosmic rays in the upper layers of the atmosphere produces, among other particles, muons with a very short lifetime (fractions of a second). In classical mechanics these particles would never have a chance of reaching the Earth's surface. Compute how fast a muon would have to fly in order to hit the Earth from a height $h = 100$ km before it decays, given that its rest lifetime is $\tau_0 \approx 2.197\ \mu\mathrm{s}$. Do not consider collisions with other particles, and express the result as a percentage of the speed of light.
problems.problem_orig:
Krátky život častice (20 b)

Interakciou s kozmickým žiarením vznikajú v horných vrstvách atmosféry okrem iných častíc aj mióny s veľmi krátkou dobou života (v zlomkoch sekundy). Pri uvažovaní klasickej mechaniky by tieto častice nikdy nemali šancu dostať sa k povrchu Zeme. Vypočítajte, ako rýchlo by musel mión letieť, aby z výšky $h = 100$ km trafil Zem skôr než zanikne, pričom jeho pokojová doba života je $\tau_0 \approx 2{,}197\ \mu\mathrm{s}$. Neuvažujte zrážky s inými časticami a výsledok vyjadrite v percentách rýchlosti svetla.

problems.problem:
The short-sighted observer (40 points)

When thinking about the optics of the eye, various distances are important. The far point is the most distant point that the eye sees sharply without accommodation (without effort of the muscles), and for a healthy eye it lies at infinity. On the other hand, the conventional visual distance (set by agreement at 25 cm) is the standard distance at which comfortable reading by a healthy person is assumed, which however already requires a certain effort of the eye (accommodation).

David is short-sighted, which he corrects with glasses. For his left eye without glasses he found that the far point lies at a distance of 1.3 m. For his right eye he found that text at a distance of 18.5 cm appears to him without glasses as if he had it at the conventional distance.

David observes the star Sirius with ordinary binoculars without using his glasses. The binoculars have central focusing for both telescopes at once and also the possibility of focusing each telescope separately. David focused both telescopes centrally, perfectly for his left eye. By how many dioptres must he now turn the correction on the right telescope in order to see sharply with his right eye as well?

Hint: Two thin lenses placed one behind the other behave as one lens whose optical power is the sum of the optical powers of the individual lenses.
problems.problem_orig:
Krátkozraký pozorovateľ (40 b)

Pri uvažovaní o optike oka sú dôležité rôzne vzdialenosti. Vzdialený bod je najvzdialenejší bod, ktorý oko vidí ostro bez akomodácie (bez námahy svalov), a pre zdravé oko leží v nekonečne. Naopak, konvenčná zraková vzdialenosť (dohodou stanovená na 25 cm) je štandardná vzdialenosť, pri ktorej sa predpokladá pohodlné čítanie u zdravého človeka, čo si však už vyžaduje určité namáhanie oka (akomodáciu).

David je krátkozraký, čo koriguje okuliarmi. O svojom ľavom oku bez okuliarov zistil, že vzdialený bod leží vo vzdialenosti 1,3 m. Pri pravom oku zistil, že text vo vzdialenosti 18,5 cm sa mu bez okuliarov javí, akoby ho mal v konvenčnej vzdialenosti.

David pozoruje hviezdu Sirius bežným binokulárom bez použitia okuliarov. Binokulár má centrálne ostrenie naraz pre oba ďalekohľady a taktiež možnosť ostrenia každého ďalekohľadu zvlášť. David zaostril centrálne oba ďalekohľady dokonale pre svoje ľavé oko. O koľko dioptrií musí teraz otočiť korekciu na pravom ďalekohľade, aby videl ostro aj pravým okom?

Nápoveda: Dve tenké šošovky postavené za sebou sa správajú ako jedna, ktorej optická mohutnosť je súčet optických mohutností jednotlivých šošoviek.

problems.problem:
ISS (50 points)

The International Space Station orbits the Earth on an orbit with a mean height above the surface of 400 km and an inclination of $51.6^\circ$. In live NASA broadcasts directly from the ISS it is clearly seen that the astronauts on board see only a small part of the Earth's surface.

(a) [20 points] What fraction of the Earth's surface can be seen from the ISS at once? Give the answer as a percentage of the Earth's surface. Neglect atmospheric refraction and the eccentricity of the ISS orbit. Consider the Earth a perfect sphere.

Hint: The formula for the area of a spherical cap $S = 2\pi hR$ may be useful.

Thanks to the orbital motion of the ISS and the rotation of the Earth, the astronauts can see a much larger part of the Earth's surface over a longer time than you computed in part (a).

(b) [30 points] Compute what fraction of the Earth's surface can in theory be glimpsed from on board the ISS over many orbits. Again give your answer as a percentage.

ISS (50 b)

Medzinárodná vesmírna stanica obieha Zem po dráhe so strednou výškou nad povrchom 400 km a sklonom $51{,}6^\circ$. Na priamych prenosoch NASA priamo z ISS jasne vidno, že astronauti na palube vidia iba malú časť zemského povrchu.

problems.problem:
Colourful (60 points)

The spectrum of solar radiation can be roughly approximated as the radiation of a black body by means of Planck's law for the surface spectral flux $F_\lambda$, a quantity representing the flux at the surface of the body per unit wavelength $\lambda$
$$F_\lambda = \frac{2\pi hc^2}{\lambda^5}\,\frac{1}{\exp\!\left(\frac{hc}{\lambda k_{\mathrm{B}}T}\right) - 1}\,, \qquad \text{(T5.1)}$$
where $h$ is the Planck constant, $c$ the speed of light, $\lambda$ the wavelength, $k_{\mathrm{B}}$ the Boltzmann constant, $T$ the effective temperature and $\exp(x)$ an alternative notation for the function $e^x$.

In observations it is customary to use the standard photometric system based on the U, B and V filters, whose parameters are summarised in Table T5.1. For simplicity consider the spectral transmission of the filters to be a constant 100 % within the band of the filter and 0 % outside it.

Tasks

(a) [30 points] Compute the absolute magnitude of the Sun in the B and V filters. Consider the spectral flux $F_\lambda$ constant within the band of the filter.

(b) [15 points] In a telescope we observe a star physically identical to the Sun, whose apparent magnitude is 27.25 mag in the B filter and 25.67 mag in the V filter. Compute its colour index $(B-V)$ and colour excess $E_{(B-V)}$.

(c) [15 points] Compute the distance of the star taking interstellar absorption into account. Assume that the magnitude of the Sun in the V filter equals the visual magnitude of the Sun. Take the value of the R-number (the extinction coefficient of direct proportionality between the absorption in the V filter and the colour excess $(B-V)$) as $R_V = 3.1$.

Table T5.1: Overview of the standard photometric filters.
$$\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{Designation} & \text{Centre of the filter} & \text{Width of the filter} \\
\hline
\mathrm{U} & 365\ \mathrm{nm} & 66\ \mathrm{nm} \\
\mathrm{B} & 445\ \mathrm{nm} & 94\ \mathrm{nm} \\
\mathrm{V} & 551\ \mathrm{nm} & 88\ \mathrm{nm} \\
\mathrm{R} & 658\ \mathrm{nm} & 138\ \mathrm{nm} \\
\mathrm{I} & 806\ \mathrm{nm} & 149\ \mathrm{nm}
\end{array}$$
problems.problem_orig:
Farebná (60 b)

Spektrum slnečného žiarenia je možné hrubo aproximovať ako žiarenie absolútne čierneho telesa pomocou Planckovho zákona pre povrchový spektrálny tok $F_\lambda$, čo je veličina predstavujúca tok na povrchu telesa na jednotku vlnovej dĺžky $\lambda$
$$F_\lambda = \frac{2\pi hc^2}{\lambda^5}\,\frac{1}{\exp\!\left(\frac{hc}{\lambda k_{\mathrm{B}}T}\right) - 1}\,, \qquad \text{(T5.1)}$$
kde $h$ je Planckova konštanta, $c$ rýchlosť svetla, $\lambda$ vlnová dĺžka, $k_{\mathrm{B}}$ Boltzmannova konštanta, $T$ efektívna teplota a $\exp(x)$ alternatívny zápis pre funkciu $e^x$.

Pri pozorovaniach je zvykom používať štandardný fotometrický systém založený na filtroch U, B a V, ktorých parametre sú zhrnuté v tabuľke T5.1. Spektrálnu priepustnosť filtrov pre jednoduchosť uvažujte ako konštantných 100 % v oblasti filtra a 0 % mimo neho.

Úlohy

(a) [30 b] Vypočítajte absolútnu magnitúdu Slnka vo filtroch B a V. Uvažujte konštantný spektrálny tok $F_\lambda$ v oblasti filtra.

(b) [15 b] V ďalekohľade pozorujeme hviezdu fyzikálne totožnú so Slnkom, ktorej zdanlivá magnitúda je 27,25 mag vo filtri B a 25,67 mag vo filtri V. Vypočítajte jej farebný index $(B-V)$ a farebný exces $E_{(B-V)}$.

(c) [15 b] Vypočítajte vzdialenosť hviezdy so zarátaním medzihviezdnej absorpcie. Predpokladajte, že magnitúda Slnka vo V filtri je rovná vizuálnej magnitúde Slnka. Hodnotu R-čísla (extinkčného koeficientu priamej úmery medzi absorpciou vo V filtri a farebným excesom $(B-V)$) uvažujte ako $R_V = 3{,}1$.

Tabuľka T5.1: Prehľad štandardných fotometrických filtrov.
$$\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{Označenie} & \text{Stred filtra} & \text{Šírka filtra} \\
\hline
\mathrm{U} & 365\ \mathrm{nm} & 66\ \mathrm{nm} \\
\mathrm{B} & 445\ \mathrm{nm} & 94\ \mathrm{nm} \\
\mathrm{V} & 551\ \mathrm{nm} & 88\ \mathrm{nm} \\
\mathrm{R} & 658\ \mathrm{nm} & 138\ \mathrm{nm} \\
\mathrm{I} & 806\ \mathrm{nm} & 149\ \mathrm{nm}
\end{array}$$

problems.problem:
Milkdromeda III (60 points)

The Andromeda Galaxy (M 31) had been approaching the Milky Way for almost 4.5 billion years — the galaxy in which the Solar System, the planet Earth and also this place, where you are just writing the national round, are located. After the merger of these two sister galaxies a new epoch will begin, in which we shall no longer speak separately of the Andromeda Galaxy and the Milky Way, but of a single new galaxy — Milkdromeda.

The brightness of a galaxy is formed by two main components — the nucleus and the disc. In this problem we shall focus on the disc, since the brightness of the nucleus dominates only in the central region of the galaxy, up to a distance of about 1.2 kpc from the centre of the galaxy. The brightness of a galaxy is usually described by the surface magnitude $\mu$, whose units are $\mathrm{mag/arcsec^2}$ (magnitude per square arcsecond of the sky). Different places of the disc of a galaxy have different brightness and hence also different surface magnitude. We shall assume that M 31 maintains a balance between the death and the formation of stars such that its absolute magnitude and the distribution of brightness of the various parts of the disc are constant in time.

(a) [15 points] Prove that the surface magnitude $\mu$ that we observe from the Earth at one particular place of the disc of the galaxy M 31 does not depend on the distance of M 31 from the Earth or on its inclination to the line of sight.

The brightness profile of the circular disc of M 31 can be modelled by an exponential decrease that is polar-symmetric about the centre of the galaxy. Written mathematically,
$$\text{brightness} = K\exp\!\left(-\frac{r}{r_s}\right)\,, \qquad \text{(T6.1)}$$
where $K$ is a constant, $r$ is the distance of the part of the disc from the centre of the galaxy and $r_s = 5.7$ kpc is the scale length, at which the brightness of the disc drops $e$ times relative to the brightness at the centre of the disc. The constant $K$ equals the brightness of the disc at the centre of the galaxy, i.e. the brightness of the centre of the galaxy after subtracting the component of brightness due to the nucleus of the galaxy. We shall denote the surface magnitude at the centre of the disc by $\mu_0$.

(b) [15 points] By rewriting relation (T6.1) in surface magnitudes using Pogson's equation, show that the surface magnitude of the disc decreases linearly with the distance $r$. As the result give the expression for $\mu$ as a function of $\mu_0$, $r$, $r_s$.

At present the galaxy M 31 is at a distance $d_{\mathrm{M31}} = 765$ kpc from the Earth, the surface magnitude of its disc at the centre is $\mu_0 = 16.7\ \mathrm{mag/arcsec^2}$, and in the night sky with the naked eye we see the disc of M 31, at the limit, up to a distance of $20'$ from its centre.

(c) [15 points] Determine up to what physical distance $r_{\lim}$ in kpc we currently see the disc of the galaxy M 31 from its centre with the naked eye. Compute the limiting surface magnitude $\mu_{\lim}$ corresponding to the distance $r_{\lim}$ that our eye can register in the disc of the galaxy M 31.

Now we move to the future, to the time just before the collision of the galaxies. For simplicity let us assume that the discs of the galaxies are oriented perpendicular to each other, have kept their circular shape, and that the Milky Way is heading towards the centre of M 31. The situation is shown in Figure T6.1.

Figure T6.1: Representation of the colliding galaxies viewed edge-on to their discs. The Earth lies on the line joining the centres of the galaxies, which are 30 kpc apart.

(d) [15 points] Compute the range of galactic latitudes $b$ at which we could observe the galactic disc of M 31 with the naked eye at the time when the situation shown in Figure T6.1 occurs. Neglect interstellar absorption.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/astronomy-olympiads-bank/main/images/sk-2026-ck-t6-1.png
problems.problem_orig:
Milkdroméda III (60 b)

Galaxia v Androméde (M 31) sa po dobu takmer 4,5 miliardy rokov približovala k Mliečnej ceste – galaxii, kde sa nachádza slnečná sústava, planéta Zem a aj toto miesto, kde práve píšete celoslovenské kolo. Po splynutí týchto dvoch sesterských galaxií nastane nová epocha, v ktorej sa už nebude hovoriť jednotlivo o galaxii v Androméde a Mliečnej ceste (po ang. Milky Way), ale o jednotnej novej galaxii – Milkdroméde.

Jasnosť galaxie je tvorená dvomi hlavnými komponentami – jadrom a diskom. V tejto úlohe sa zameriame na disk, keďže jasnosť jadra dominuje iba v centrálnej oblasti galaxie do vzdialenosti asi 1,2 kpc od stredu galaxie. Jasnosť galaxie sa zvykne popisovať pomocou plošnej magnitúdy $\mu$, ktorej jednotky sú $\mathrm{mag/arcsec^2}$ (magnitúda na štvorcovú uhlovú sekundu oblohy). Rôzne miesta disku galaxie majú rozdielnu jasnosť, a teda aj rozdielnu plošnú magnitúdu. Budeme predpokladať, že si M 31 udržuje rovnováhu medzi zánikom a tvorbou hviezd tak, že jej absolútna magnitúda a rozloženie jasností rôznych častí disku sú v čase konštantné.

(a) [15 b] Dokážte, že plošná magnitúda $\mu$, ktorú pozorujeme zo Zeme v jednom konkrétnom mieste disku galaxie M 31, nezávisí od vzdialenosti M 31 od Zeme a jej inklinácie voči zornému lúču.

Profil jasnosti kruhového disku M 31 môžeme modelovať exponenciálnym poklesom, ktorý je polárne symetrický okolo stredu galaxie. Matematicky zapísané
$$\text{jasnosť} = K\exp\!\left(-\frac{r}{r_s}\right)\,, \qquad \text{(T6.1)}$$
kde $K$ je konštanta, $r$ je vzdialenosť časti disku od stredu galaxie a $r_s = 5{,}7$ kpc je škálovacia vzdialenosť, v ktorej jasnosť disku klesne $e$-krát voči jasnosti v strede disku. Konštanta $K$ je rovná jasnosti disku v strede galaxie, teda jasnosti stredu galaxie po odpočítaní zložky jasnosti pre jadro galaxie. Plošnú magnitúdu v strede disku budeme označovať $\mu_0$.

(b) [15 b] Prepísaním vzťahu (T6.1) do plošných magnitúd pomocou Pogsonovej rovnice ukážte, že plošná magnitúda disku klesá lineárne so vzdialenosťou $r$. Ako výsledok uveďte vyjadrenie pre $\mu$ v závislosti od $\mu_0$, $r$, $r_s$.

V súčasnosti sa galaxia M 31 nachádza vo vzdialenosti $d_{\mathrm{M31}} = 765$ kpc od Zeme, jej plošná magnitúda disku v strede je $\mu_0 = 16{,}7\ \mathrm{mag/arcsec^2}$ a na nočnej oblohe voľným okom limitne vidíme disk M 31 do vzdialenosti $20'$ od jeho stredu.

(c) [15 b] Určte, do akej fyzickej vzdialenosti $r_{\lim}$ v kpc vidíme v súčasnosti voľným okom disk galaxie M 31 od jeho stredu. Vypočítajte limitnú plošnú magnitúdu $\mu_{\lim}$ zodpovedajúcu vzdialenosti $r_{\lim}$, ktorú dokáže naše oko zaznamenať v disku galaxie M 31.

Teraz sa presunieme do budúcnosti do času tesne pred zrážkou galaxií. Pre jednoduchosť uvažujme, že disky galaxií sú orientované kolmo na seba, zachovali si kruhový tvar a Mliečna cesta mieri do stredu M 31. Situácia je zobrazená na obrázku T6.1.

Obr. T6.1: Znázornenie zrážajúcich sa galaxií pri pohľade z boku ich diskov. Zem leží na spojnici stredov galaxií, ktoré sú od seba vzdialené 30 kpc.

(d) [15 b] Vypočítajte rozsah galaktických šírok $b$, na ktorých by sme mohli voľným okom pozorovať galaktický disk M 31 v čase, kedy nastane situácia zobrazená na obrázku T6.1. Zanedbajte medzihviezdnu absorpciu.

problems.problem:
Limiting magnitude of a camera (75 points)

Light pollution is growing at a fast rate of almost 10 % a year, which makes the naturally dark sky an endangered rarity. In Slovakia the darkest place is the Poloniny Dark Sky Park ($\varphi = 49.03^\circ$ N, $\lambda = 22.45^\circ$ E), where the brightness of the night sky reaches limiting values of the surface magnitude $\mu_1 \approx 22\ \mathrm{mag/arcsec^2}$. For astrophotographers it is very important under such conditions to find out how to set the exposure so as to capture the faintest possible objects without the stars being smeared because of the rotation of the Earth.

In this problem we shall deal with photography with a Nikon D780 digital SLR camera with a full-frame CMOS sensor (dimensions $a \times b = 35.9\ \mathrm{mm} \times 23.9\ \mathrm{mm}$, number of square pixels $N_p = 24$ MPx) and a lens with focal length $f = 50$ mm and focal ratio (F-ratio) $f/1.8$. Assume that we photograph stars with declination $\delta = 30^\circ$, and that we do not use a motorised mount.

(a) [13 points] Compute the longest exposure time $\tau$ at which so-called star trails do not form. As the condition for the formation of star trails we take that the image of a star must travel on the sensor a path equal to at least the side of a square pixel of the sensor.

The ability of the sensor to record a faint star is limited by the noise $N$. The working of a CMOS sensor is, in a simplified way, based on the photons falling on a pixel "knocking out" electrons from its surface, which accumulate in it as a charge (the ratio of the number of knocked-out electrons per photon is called the quantum efficiency $\eta$). After the end of the exposure this charge is converted to a voltage, amplified, and changed in an A/D converter into a digital value DN (Digital Number). This process is not perfect and several noise components enter the signal:
- The photon shot noise of the star's radiation itself has the variance $\sigma_{PN}^2 = S$, where $S$ is the signal, i.e. the number of recorded electrons $e^-$.
- The dark current noise is $\sigma_{DC}^2 = n_{px}\cdot DC\cdot\tau$, where $n_{px}$ is the number of pixels from which the information is read and $DC$ is the dark current of the sensor, for which $DC = 0.1\ e^-/\text{pixel/s}$.
- The readout noise arises in the reading of the signal from the pixel and its digitisation. Its value in digital units (DN) depends on the ISO setting. For it $\sigma_{RN}^2 = n_{px}\cdot RN^2$, where $RN$ is the noise in electrons, which you can read from the attached graph. For the conversion from digital units (DN) to electrons ($e^-$) use the conversion gain (Gain), which you can also read from the attached graph. The conversion relation is: Signal [$e^-$] = Signal [DN] $\cdot$ Gain.
- The background sky noise equals directly the number of electrons produced as a result of photons from the sky falling on the pixels, i.e. $\sigma_{\mathrm{sky}}^2 = S_{\mathrm{sky}}$.

Additional information:
- We shall see the star in the photograph if the signal-to-noise ratio is at least 3, i.e. $S/N \geq 3$.
- We photograph at sensitivity ISO 800.
- The quantum efficiency of the whole apparatus at the considered wavelength of photography $\lambda = 500$ nm is $\eta = 60\,\%\ (e^-/\text{photon})$.
- The bandwidth that the sensor transmits is $\Delta\lambda = 100$ nm.
- The reference light flux $\Phi_0$ for zero surface magnitude ($\mu_0 = 0\ \mathrm{mag/arcsec^2}$) equals $\Phi_0 = 10^4\ \text{photons}\ \mathrm{cm^{-2}\,s^{-1}\,nm^{-1}}$.
- Because of seeing, the effectively point-like star is not imaged on one pixel only. Assume that the image of the star is uniformly "smeared" over 4 neighbouring pixels.
- You determine the total noise as $N = \sqrt{\sigma_{PN}^2 + \sigma_{DC}^2 + \sigma_{RN}^2 + \sigma_{\mathrm{sky}}^2}$.

(b) [5 points] Compute the area of the sky in $\mathrm{arcsec^2}$ from which the sky noise is collected.

(c) [57 points] Compute the limiting magnitude $m$ of stars that we are able to capture in the considered part of the sky with a photograph of exposure time $\tau$.

Figure T7.1: Graph of $\log_2(\mathrm{DN})$ as a function of the ISO setting. Figure T7.2: Graph of $\log_2(\mathrm{Gain})$ as a function of the ISO setting. Source given in the paper: photonstophotos.net. [The graphs are not reproduced here; they are on page 17 of the official file: https://www.astronomickaolympiada.sk/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/AO2026-CK-SS-vzoraky-1.pdf]
problems.problem_orig:
Limitná magnitúda fotoaparátu (75 b)

Svetelné znečistenie rastie rýchlym tempom takmer o 10 % ročne, čo robí z prirodzene tmavej oblohy ohrozený unikát. Na Slovensku je najtmavším miestom Park tmavej oblohy Poloniny ($\varphi = 49{,}03^\circ$ N, $\lambda = 22{,}45^\circ$ E), kde jas nočnej oblohy dosahuje limitné hodnoty plošnej magnitúdy $\mu_1 \approx 22\ \mathrm{mag/arcsec^2}$. Pre astrofotografov je v takýchto podmienkach veľmi dôležité zistiť, ako nastaviť expozíciu tak, aby zachytili čo najslabšie objekty bez toho, aby boli hviezdy v dôsledku rotácie Zeme rozmazané.

V tejto úlohe sa budeme zaoberať fotením s digitálnou zrkadlovkou Nikon D780 s full-frame CMOS senzorom (rozmery $a \times b = 35{,}9\ \mathrm{mm} \times 23{,}9\ \mathrm{mm}$, počet štvorcových pixelov $N_p = 24$ MPx) a objektívom s ohniskovou vzdialenosťou $f = 50$ mm a svetelnosťou (F-ratio) $f/1.8$. Uvažujte, že fotíme hviezdy s deklináciou $\delta = 30^\circ$ a predpokladajte, že nepoužívame motorizovanú montáž.

(a) [13 b] Vypočítajte najdlhšiu expozičnú dobu $\tau$, pri ktorej nebudú vznikať takzvané star trails. Ako podmienku na vznik star trails budeme považovať, že obraz hviezdy musí na senzore prejsť dráhu rovnú aspoň veľkosti strany štvorcového pixela senzora.

Schopnosť senzora zaznamenať slabú hviezdu je limitovaná šumom $N$. Proces fungovania CMOS senzora je zjednodušene založený na tom, že fotóny dopadajúce na pixel z jeho povrchu „vybijú“ elektróny, ktoré sa v ňom akumulujú ako náboj (pomer počtu vybitých elektrónov na jeden fotón sa nazýva kvantová účinnosť $\eta$). Po ukončení expozície sa tento náboj premení na napätie, zosilní sa a v A/D prevodníku sa zmení na digitálnu hodnotu DN (Digital Number). Tento proces nie je dokonalý a do signálu vstupuje niekoľko zložiek šumu:
- Fotónový šum (photon shot noise) samotného žiarenia hviezdy je rozptyl $\sigma_{PN}^2 = S$, kde $S$ je signál, teda počet zaznamenaných elektrónov $e^-$.
- Tmavý šum (dark current noise) je $\sigma_{DC}^2 = n_{px}\cdot DC\cdot\tau$, kde $n_{px}$ je počet pixelov, z ktorých sa vyčítava informácia, a $DC$ tmavý prúd (dark current) senzora, pre ktorý platí $DC = 0{,}1\ e^-/\text{pixel/s}$.
- Vyčítací šum (readout noise) vzniká pri samotnom čítaní signálu z pixelu a jeho digitalizácii. Jeho hodnota v digitálnych jednotkách (DN) závisí od nastavenia ISO. Platí preň vzťah $\sigma_{RN}^2 = n_{px}\cdot RN^2$, kde $RN$ je šum v elektrónoch, ktorý viete odčítať z priloženého grafu. Pre prevod z digitálnych jednotiek (DN) na elektróny ($e^-$) použite konverzný zisk (Gain), ktorý takisto viete odčítať z priloženého grafu. Platí prevodový vzťah: Signál [$e^-$] = Signál [DN] $\cdot$ Gain.
- Šum pozadia oblohy (background sky noise) sa rovná priamo počtu elektrónov, ktoré vznikajú ako dôsledok dopadu fotónov z oblohy na pixely, teda $\sigma_{\mathrm{sky}}^2 = S_{\mathrm{sky}}$.

Doplňujúce informácie:
- Hviezdu na fotke uvidíme, ak je pomer signálu k šumu (Signal-to-Noise ratio) rovný aspoň 3, teda $S/N \geq 3$.
- Fotíme na citlivosti ISO 800.
- Kvantová účinnosť celej aparatúry na uvažovanej vlnovej dĺžke fotenia $\lambda = 500$ nm je $\eta = 60\,\%\ (e^-/\text{fotón})$.
- Šírka pásma, ktorú senzor prepúšťa, je $\Delta\lambda = 100$ nm.
- Referenčný svetelný tok $\Phi_0$ pre nulovú plošnú magnitúdu ($\mu_0 = 0\ \mathrm{mag/arcsec^2}$) je rovný $\Phi_0 = 10^4\ \text{fotónov}\ \mathrm{cm^{-2}\,s^{-1}\,nm^{-1}}$.
- Kvôli seeingu sa efektívne bodová hviezda nezobrazí iba na jeden pixel. Predpokladajte, že obraz hviezdy bude rovnomerne „rozmazaný“ na 4 susedných pixeloch.
- Celkový šum určíte ako $N = \sqrt{\sigma_{PN}^2 + \sigma_{DC}^2 + \sigma_{RN}^2 + \sigma_{\mathrm{sky}}^2}$.

(b) [5 b] Vypočítajte plochu oblohy v $\mathrm{arcsec^2}$, z ktorej sa zbiera šum oblohy.

(c) [57 b] Vypočítajte limitnú magnitúdu hviezd $m$, ktoré sme v uvažovanej časti oblohy schopní zachytiť fotografiou s dĺžkou expozície $\tau$.

Obr. T7.1: Graf závislosti $\log_2(\mathrm{DN})$ od nastavenia ISO. Obr. T7.2: Graf závislosti $\log_2(\mathrm{Gain})$ od nastavenia ISO. Zdroj: photonstophotos.net. problems.problem:
Motion of a star (80 points)

Most exoplanets are nowadays discovered indirectly, for example by following the drop in brightness of the star during a transit of the planet, or by measuring changes of its radial velocity. Another method, extremely demanding on the precision of instruments, is astrometry, i.e. direct observation of the motion of the central star due to the gravitational influence of the planets orbiting it.

Let us consider a stellar system in which two planets orbit the parent star on circular orbits in a plane perpendicular to the line of sight. For simplicity let us denote these planets A and B such that the orbital radius of planet A is larger than the orbital radius of planet B.

The attached figure shows the trajectory of the centre of the parent star (after subtracting its proper, parallactic and aberrational motion); we know that the centre of the star traces this whole trajectory in a time $t = 10$ years and then the motion along the trajectory repeats periodically. Further, let us assume that the masses of both planets are negligibly small compared with the mass of the star, so that we can also neglect the gravitational influence of the planets on each other.

(a) [40 points] On the basis of the figure and the given data determine the sidereal orbital periods $T_A$, $T_B$ of both planets.

(b) [40 points] By an independent observation of planet A we found that its orbital radius is $r_A = 5.5$ au. On the basis of this value, the previous data and measurements from the attached figure, determine the mass of the star $M$ and the masses of both planets $m_A$, $m_B$.

Figure T8.1: Trajectory of the centre of the parent star (axes $x$, $y$ in units of $10^{8}$ m).

problems.problem_orig:
Pohyb hviezdy (80 b)

Väčšina exoplanét sa v súčasnosti objavuje nepriamo, napríklad sledovaním poklesu jasnosti hviezdy pri tranzite planéty alebo meraním zmien jej radiálnej rýchlosti. Ďalšou, na presnosť prístrojov však extrémne náročnou metódou je astrometria, teda priame pozorovanie pohybu centrálnej hviezdy v dôsledku gravitačného vplyvu planét obiehajúcich okolo nej.

Uvažujme hviezdnu sústavu, v ktorej okolo materskej hviezdy obiehajú po kruhových dráhach dve planéty v rovine kolmej na zorný lúč. Pre jednoduchosť tieto planéty ďalej označme ako A a B tak, aby polomer dráhy planéty A bol väčší ako polomer dráhy planéty B.

Na priloženom obrázku je znázornená trajektória stredu materskej hviezdy (po odčítaní jej vlastného, paralaktického a aberačného pohybu), pričom vieme, že stred hviezdy opíše celú túto trajektóriu za čas $t = 10$ rokov a potom sa pohyb po trajektórii periodicky opakuje. Ďalej predpokladajme, že hmotnosti oboch planét sú zanedbateľne malé v porovnaní s hmotnosťou hviezdy, a tak môžeme aj gravitačný vplyv planét na seba navzájom zanedbať.

(a) [40 b] Na základe obrázka a zadaných údajov určte siderické obežné periódy $T_A$, $T_B$ oboch planét.

(b) [40 b] Nezávislým pozorovaním planéty A sme zistili, že polomer jej dráhy je $r_A = 5{,}5$ au. Na základe tejto hodnoty, predošlých údajov a meraní z priloženého obrázka určte hmotnosť hviezdy $M$ a hmotnosti oboch planét $m_A$, $m_B$.

Obr. T8.1: Trajektória stredu materskej hviezdy.

problems.problem:
MIThenge (90 points)

At the American university MIT there is a long main corridor, the Infinite Corridor. Several times a year it happens that the Sun gets on the sky into exactly such a position that it shines through the glazed doors and along the whole corridor. Since the view from the eastern part is blocked by another building, this phenomenon occurs only at sunsets.

Seen from the eastern end of the corridor, the centre of its western end is at the azimuth $A = 245.81^\circ$ (the azimuth is measured from the north towards the east). The length of the corridor is $l = 250$ m, its height $h = 4$ m and its width $w = 2.75$ m. The coordinates of MIT are $\phi = 42.36^\circ$ N and $\lambda = 71.09^\circ$ W. Consider an observer of height $h_p = 2$ m standing at the centre of the eastern end of the corridor.

In this problem neglect atmospheric refraction at the horizon, the eccentricity of the Earth's orbit and the influence of the inclination of the Earth's axis on the equation of time. Assume that the declination of the Sun does not change during the day.

(a) [5 points] Compute the angular dimensions of the western end of the corridor for this observer.

(b) [25 points] Derive the equation for the dependence of the declination of the Sun on the day of the year.

(c) [25 points] Find for what declination the Sun will set at the azimuth $A$.

(d) [35 points] Using these relations and values, find when the next MIThenge will occur, i.e. the date on which the Sun has the declination determined in part (c). Further find the time at which sunset occurs on that day. It will be useful to know that the vernal equinox occurred on 20 March 2026 and that MIT is in the EST time zone, i.e. UTC−5.
problems.problem_orig:
MIThenge (90 b)

Na americkej univerzite MIT sa nachádza dlhá hlavná chodba – the Infinite Corridor. Niekoľkokrát za rok sa stane, že sa Slnko na oblohe dostane presne do takej polohy, že presvieti cez presklené dvere a cez celú chodbu. Keďže je výhľad z východnej časti blokovaný inou budovou, tak tento úkaz nastáva iba pri západoch Slnka.

Pri pohľade z východného konca chodby sa stred jej západného konca nachádza na azimute $A = 245{,}81^\circ$ (azimut je meraný od severu smerom na východ). Dĺžka chodby je $l = 250$ m, výška je $h = 4$ m a šírka $w = 2{,}75$ m. Súradnice MIT sú $\phi = 42{,}36^\circ$ N a $\lambda = 71{,}09^\circ$ W. Uvažujte pozorovateľa s výškou $h_p = 2$ m stojaceho v strede východného konca chodby.

V tejto úlohe zanedbajte atmosférickú refrakciu pri horizonte, excentricitu zemskej orbity a vplyv inklinácie zemskej osi na časovú rovnicu. Predpokladajte, že deklinácia Slnka sa počas dňa nemení.

(a) [5 b] Vypočítajte uhlové rozmery západného konca chodby pre tohto pozorovateľa.

(b) [25 b] Odvoďte rovnicu závislosti deklinácie Slnka od dňa roka.

(c) [25 b] Zistite, pre akú deklináciu bude Slnko zapadať na azimute $A$.

(d) [35 b] Pomocou týchto vzťahov a hodnôt zistite, kedy nastane najbližší MIThenge, teda dátum, kedy má Slnko deklináciu určenú v podzadaní (c). Ďalej zistite čas, kedy v daný deň nastane západ Slnka. Bude sa vám hodiť vedieť, že jarná rovnodennosť nastala 20. marca 2026 a že sa MIT nachádza v časovom pásme EST, teda UTC-5.

problems.problem:
Cosmological supernova (90 points)

On 30 December 2010 the Hubble Space Telescope (HST) discovered in the constellation Cetus one of the most distant supernovae. This supernova was designated SN UDS10Wil and its redshift was determined to be greater than 1, specifically $z = 1.91$. At such high redshifts the Hubble–Lemaître law, which is only an approximation for the nearby Universe, no longer holds.

(a) [15 points] One of the filters through which HST observed was the infrared filter F160W. The graph of its throughput as a function of wavelength is shown in Figure T10.1 below. By throughput we mean the ratio of the amount of light that passes through the filter to the total amount of incident light, expressed as a percentage. From the graph read off the interval $\mathbb{F}_0 = (\lambda_{\min,0}, \lambda_{\max,0})$ of wavelengths that the filter transmits, and estimate its mean throughput $\eta$ in percent. Also estimate the uncertainties of $\lambda_{\min,0}$, $\lambda_{\max,0}$ and $\eta$.

Figure T10.1: Graph of the throughput of the filter F160W as a function of wavelength. One angstrom (Å) equals $0.1\ \mathrm{nm} = 10^{-10}\ \mathrm{m}$. Source: Hubble Space Telescope User Documentation.

(b) [10 points] When observed by HST in the filter F160W, the supernova shone brightest with an apparent magnitude $m'_{\mathbb{F}_0} = 26.9$ mag. Correct this magnitude for the mean throughput of the filter that you determined in (a). In other words, determine the real apparent magnitude $m_{\mathbb{F}_0}$ of the supernova when observed in the range of wavelengths in the interval $\mathbb{F}_0$. Do not determine the uncertainty of $m_{\mathbb{F}_0}$.

Table T10.1: Overview of the standard photometric filters.
$$\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{Designation} & \text{Centre of the filter} & \text{Width of the filter} \\
\hline
\mathrm{U} & 3650\ \text{Å} & 660\ \text{Å} \\
\mathrm{B} & 4450\ \text{Å} & 940\ \text{Å} \\
\mathrm{V} & 5510\ \text{Å} & 880\ \text{Å} \\
\mathrm{R} & 6580\ \text{Å} & 1380\ \text{Å} \\
\mathrm{I} & 8060\ \text{Å} & 1490\ \text{Å}
\end{array}$$

(c) [15 points] Every wave of radiation travelling through the Universe is stretched as a result of the expansion of the Universe. Compute to which interval of wavelengths $\mathbb{F} = (\lambda_{\min}, \lambda_{\max})$ the detection interval $\mathbb{F}_0$ corresponded when the radiation was emitted by the supernova. Also compute the uncertainty of $\lambda_{\min}$ and $\lambda_{\max}$ on the basis of the uncertainties of $\lambda_{\min,0}$ and $\lambda_{\max,0}$ that you estimated in (a). To which filter of the standard photometric system (Table T10.1) does the interval $\mathbb{F}$ correspond most closely?

On cosmological scales there are several different definitions of distance. One of them is the luminosity distance $d_{\mathrm{L}}$, which is defined by means of the distance modulus as
$$m_{\mathbb{F}_0} - M_{\mathbb{F}} = 5\log d_{\mathrm{L}} - 5\,, \qquad [d_{\mathrm{L}}] = \mathrm{pc}\,, \qquad \text{(T10.1)}$$
where $m_{\mathbb{F}_0}$ is the apparent and $M_{\mathbb{F}}$ the absolute magnitude in the given intervals of wavelengths. We have neglected the absorption of radiation and the K-correction, which would be necessary if we did not work in the corresponding intervals $\mathbb{F}_0$ and $\mathbb{F}$.

For describing cosmological structures a more suitable definition of distance is the so-called comoving distance $d_{\mathrm{C}}$. Let us consider the standard $\Lambda$CDM cosmological model and a flat Universe. The comoving distance can then be expressed as
$$d_{\mathrm{C}} = d_{\mathrm{H}}\,f(z)\,, \qquad \text{(T10.2)}$$
where $d_{\mathrm{H}} = c/H_0$ is the Hubble distance, $c$ the speed of light, $H_0$ the Hubble constant and $f(z)$ a complicated function of the redshift shown in Figure T10.2. Moreover, between the luminosity and the comoving distance there is the simple relation $d_{\mathrm{L}} = (1 + z)\,d_{\mathrm{C}}$.

Figure T10.2: Graph of the function $f(z)$ for computing the comoving distance $d_{\mathrm{C}}$. The dashed line shows the approximation for small redshifts $z$ (the Hubble–Lemaître law).

(d) [35 points] Compute $M_{\mathbb{F}}$. Do not determine the uncertainty.

The expansion of the Universe causes the stretching of the waves of electromagnetic radiation, and hence also the lengthening of their periods. At the same time, however, other time intervals (those that are much shorter than the age of the Universe) are lengthened in the same proportion, including the duration of the afterglow of a supernova. It was observed that after the maximum brightness the magnitude of the supernova increased by 1.5 mag in $\Delta t_0 = 67$ days.

(e) [10 points] Compute the real duration of the afterglow $\Delta t$, i.e. the time interval in which the absolute magnitude of the supernova rose from the maximum value $M_{\mathbb{F}}$ by 1.5 mag.

(f) [5 points] On the basis of the maximum absolute magnitude $M_{\mathbb{F}}$ and the afterglow time $\Delta t$ estimate the type of the supernova SN UDS10Wil. Use the graph of the typical course of the light curve for various types of supernovae in Figure T10.3, which is drawn in the so-called rest frame, i.e. in the reference frame at rest with respect to the supernova.

Figure T10.3: Typical light curves of various types of supernovae. The horizontal axis shows the time in days since the peak luminosity, the time scale being in the rest frame of the supernova. The vertical axis shows the absolute visual magnitude. The type of supernova is distinguished by colour; the legend is above the graph. Author: Lithopsian. [The graph is not reproduced here; it is on page 32 of the official file: https://www.astronomickaolympiada.sk/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/AO2026-CK-SS-vzoraky-1.pdf]

problems.problem_orig:
Kozmologická supernova (90 b)

30. decembra 2010 Hubblov vesmírny ďalekohľad (HST) objavil v súhvezdí Veľryba jednu z najvzdialenejších supernov. Táto supernova bola označená ako SN UDS10Wil a jej červený posun bol určený na väčší ako 1, konkrétne $z = 1{,}91$. Pri takto vysokých červených posunoch už neplatí Hubblov–Lemaîtreov zákon, ktorý je iba aproximáciou pre blízky vesmír.

(a) [15 b] Jeden z filtrov, cez ktorý HST pozoroval, bol infračervený filter F160W. Graf závislosti jeho priepustnosti od vlnovej dĺžky je zobrazený na obrázku T10.1 nižšie. Pod priepustnosťou rozumieme pomer množstva svetla, ktoré prejde cez filter, k celkovému množstvu dopadajúceho svetla, vyjadrený v percentách. Z grafu odčítajte interval $\mathbb{F}_0 = (\lambda_{\min,0}, \lambda_{\max,0})$ vlnových dĺžok, ktoré filter prepúšťa, a odhadnite jeho priemernú priepustnosť $\eta$ v percentách. Takisto odhadnite neistotu $\lambda_{\min,0}$, $\lambda_{\max,0}$ a $\eta$.

Obr. T10.1: Graf závislosti priepustnosti (throughput) vo filtri F160W od vlnovej dĺžky (wavelength). Jeden angstrom (Å) je rovný $0{,}1\ \mathrm{nm} = 10^{-10}\ \mathrm{m}$. Zdroj: Hubble Space Telescope User Documentation.

(b) [10 b] Pri pozorovaní HST vo filtri F160W supernova najjasnejšie zasvietila so zdanlivou magnitúdou $m'_{\mathbb{F}_0} = 26{,}9$ mag. Túto magnitúdu opravte o priemernú priepustnosť filtra, ktorú ste stanovili v (a). Inými slovami, určte reálnu zdanlivú magnitúdu $m_{\mathbb{F}_0}$ supernovy pri pozorovaní v oblasti vlnových dĺžok v intervale $\mathbb{F}_0$. Neistotu $m_{\mathbb{F}_0}$ neurčujte.

Tabuľka T10.1: Prehľad štandardných fotometrických filtrov.
$$\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{Označenie} & \text{Stred filtra} & \text{Šírka filtra} \\
\hline
\mathrm{U} & 3650\ \text{Å} & 660\ \text{Å} \\
\mathrm{B} & 4450\ \text{Å} & 940\ \text{Å} \\
\mathrm{V} & 5510\ \text{Å} & 880\ \text{Å} \\
\mathrm{R} & 6580\ \text{Å} & 1380\ \text{Å} \\
\mathrm{I} & 8060\ \text{Å} & 1490\ \text{Å}
\end{array}$$

(c) [15 b] Každá vlna žiarenia putujúca vesmírom sa predlžuje v dôsledku rozpínania vesmíru. Vypočítajte, akému intervalu vlnových dĺžok $\mathbb{F} = (\lambda_{\min}, \lambda_{\max})$ zodpovedal detekčný interval $\mathbb{F}_0$ pri emitovaní žiarenia supernovou. Takisto vypočítajte neistotu $\lambda_{\min}$ a $\lambda_{\max}$ na základe neistot $\lambda_{\min,0}$ a $\lambda_{\max,0}$, ktoré ste odhadli v (a). Akému filtru zo štandardného fotometrického systému (tabuľka T10.1) najbližšie zodpovedá interval $\mathbb{F}$?

Na kozmologických škálach existuje viacero rôznych definícií vzdialenosti. Jednou z nich je luminozitná vzdialenosť $d_{\mathrm{L}}$, ktorá je definovaná pomocou modulu vzdialenosti ako
$$m_{\mathbb{F}_0} - M_{\mathbb{F}} = 5\log d_{\mathrm{L}} - 5\,, \qquad [d_{\mathrm{L}}] = \mathrm{pc}\,, \qquad \text{(T10.1)}$$
kde $m_{\mathbb{F}_0}$ je zdanlivá a $M_{\mathbb{F}}$ absolútna magnitúda v daných intervaloch vlnových dĺžok. Zanedbali sme absorpciu žiarenia a K-korekciu, ktorá by bola potrebná, ak by sme nepracovali v zodpovedajúcich si intervaloch $\mathbb{F}_0$ a $\mathbb{F}$.

Na popisovanie kozmologických štruktúr je vhodnejšou definíciou vzdialenosti takzvaná comoving distance $d_{\mathrm{C}}$. Uvažujme štandardný $\Lambda$CDM kozmologický model a plochý vesmír. Comoving vzdialenosť vieme potom vyjadriť ako
$$d_{\mathrm{C}} = d_{\mathrm{H}}\,f(z)\,, \qquad \text{(T10.2)}$$
kde $d_{\mathrm{H}} = c/H_0$ je Hubblova vzdialenosť, $c$ rýchlosť svetla, $H_0$ Hubblova konštanta a $f(z)$ komplikovaná funkcia červeného posunu zobrazená na obrázku T10.2. Medzi luminozitnou a comoving vzdialenosťou navyše platí jednoduchý vzťah $d_{\mathrm{L}} = (1 + z)\,d_{\mathrm{C}}$.

Obr. T10.2: Graf funkcie $f(z)$ pre výpočet comoving vzdialenosti $d_{\mathrm{C}}$. Prerušovanou čiarou je zobrazená aproximácia pre malé červené posuny $z$ (Hubblov-Lemaîtreov zákon).

(d) [35 b] Vypočítajte $M_{\mathbb{F}}$. Neistotu neurčujte.

Rozpínanie vesmíru spôsobuje naťahovanie vĺn elektromagnetického žiarenia, a teda aj predlžovanie ich periód. Zároveň sa ale v rovnakom pomere predlžujú aj ďalšie časové intervaly (tie, ktoré sú výrazne kratšie ako vek vesmíru), vrátane dĺžky dosvitu supernovy. Bolo pozorované, že po maxime jasnosti narástla magnitúda supernovy o 1,5 mag za $\Delta t_0 = 67$ dní.

(e) [10 b] Vypočítajte reálnu dĺžku dosvitu $\Delta t$, čiže časový interval, za ktorý stúpla absolútna magnitúda supernovy z maximálnej hodnoty $M_{\mathbb{F}}$ o hodnotu 1,5 mag.

(f) [5 b] Na základe maximálnej absolútnej magnitúdy $M_{\mathbb{F}}$ a času dosvitu $\Delta t$ odhadnite typ supernovy SN UDS10Wil. Využite graf typického priebehu svetelnej krivky pre rôzne typy supernov na obrázku T10.3, ktorý je nakreslený v takzvanom rest frame, teda vo vzťažnej sústave, ktorá je v pokoji vzhľadom na supernovu.

Obr. T10.3: Typické priebehy svetelných kriviek pre rôzne typy supernov. Na horizontálnej osi je znázornený čas v jednotke dní od najvyššej jasnosti (Days since peak luminosity), pričom časová škála je v takzvanom rest frame, teda vo vzťažnej sústave, ktorá je v pokoji vzhľadom na supernovu. Na vertikálnej osi je znázornená absolútna vizuálna magnitúda – Absolute magnitude (visual). Typ supernovy je rozlíšený farebne, legenda je uvedená nad grafom. Autor: Lithopsian. [Graf sa tu nereprodukuje; nachádza sa na strane 32 oficiálneho súboru: https://www.astronomickaolympiada.sk/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/AO2026-CK-SS-vzoraky-1.pdf]

problems.problem:
Luminosity of a star (180 points)

A. Empirical observations

In astrophysics we often meet a relation expressing the proportionality between the luminosity $L$ of a star and its mass $M$. It follows from the attached graph that stars in different intervals behave according to different power laws of the form
$$\frac{L}{L_\odot} = b\left(\frac{M}{M_\odot}\right)^{a}\,. \qquad \text{(T11.1)}$$

A.1 [30 points] On the basis of the attached graph divide the stars according to their mass into several suitable intervals and for each interval compute the coefficients $a$, $b$.

Figure T11.1: Logarithmic graph of $L/L_\odot$ as a function of $M/M_\odot$.

B. Theoretical calculation of the temperature

We shall consider a simple model of a spherical non-rotating star of mass $M$ and radius $R$ consisting only of hydrogen plasma (fully ionised hydrogen, i.e. there are only hydrogen nuclei and electrons in the star). The star can be regarded as a set of thin concentric spherical shells of thickness $\Delta r \ll R$ and density $\rho(r)$.

In the analysis of fluid bodies we are often interested in hydrostatic equilibrium, which occurs when the resultant of the gravitational force and the pressure forces is zero.

B.1 [15 points] Write the equation of hydrostatic equilibrium for the shell at a distance $r$ from the centre of the star. Express the result in terms of $r$, $\Delta r$, $\rho(r)$, the pressure difference between neighbouring shells $\Delta p(r)$, the mass of gas below the shell $M_{\mathrm{p}}(r)$ and basic physical constants. Figure T11.2 may be useful.

Figure T11.2: The spherical shell is acted on from inside by the pressure $p(r)$ and from outside by $p(r + \Delta r)$.

In the following parts we shall take $\rho(r) = \text{const.} = \rho$ and also a constant temperature $T(r) = \text{const.}$ Further let us assume that at the surface of the star the pressure is $p(R) = 0$ and the pressure at the centre of the star is $p(0) = p_0$. For a rough estimate we shall assume that the star consists of only two shells of equal mass.

B.2 [10 points] Using the result of part B.1, compute the pressure at the centre of the star only in terms of $M$, $R$ and basic physical constants.

B.3 [10 points] Express the temperature of the Sun $T_1$ assuming that the plasma behaves as an ideal gas. Express the answer in terms of $M$, $R$ and basic physical constants.

At low temperatures (less than millions of degrees) hydrogen forms diatomic molecules $\mathrm{H_2}$, but in the Sun, where the temperature in the core is roughly 15 million kelvins, it is in a fully ionised state in the form of protons. These are therefore monatomic molecules, so ionised hydrogen has $s = 3$ degrees of freedom (it can move in the directions $x$, $y$, $z$).

B.4 [15 points] Using the virial theorem compute the mean temperature $T_2$ inside the star. Express the result in terms of $M$, $R$ and basic physical constants.
Hint: The work you would do to take apart all the massive particles forming a homogeneous spherical distribution of mass $M$ and radius $R$, from this distribution to infinite distance from each other, equals $3GM^2/(5R)$.

Inside the Sun (and main-sequence stars) energy is produced by exoenergetic nuclear reactions. The basic process is the fusion of hydrogen nuclei ($\mathrm{H^+}$) in the so-called proton–proton (p–p) chain. The first reaction of this process is the fusion of two protons
$$\mathrm{p} + \mathrm{p} \to {}^{2}_{1}\mathrm{D} + e^+ + \nu_e\,. \qquad \text{(T11.2)}$$

B.5 [15 points] Compute the temperature of the star $T_3$ needed for the fusion of protons, if their fusion occurs when they approach each other to a distance $d_p = 1.5\cdot10^{-15}$ m. Assume that the initial distance of the protons is much larger than $d_p$ and that both head directly towards each other with the same speed. Use only knowledge of classical physics.

B.6 [10 points] Compare the results obtained in parts B.3, B.4 and B.5. In which part is the determined temperature closest to the temperature of the Sun? Briefly explain the differences between the individual computed temperatures and the actual value for the Sun.

C. Calculation of the radiant power

The fusion of protons produces a positron ($e^+$), which then annihilates with electrons ($e^-$) present in the star:
$$e^+ + e^- \to 2\gamma\,. \qquad \text{(T11.3)}$$
The annihilation produces photons ($\gamma$), which however do not escape from the star directly. They are scattered and enter a large number of thermonuclear reactions before they reach the surface. These random processes can be described by a process called diffusion, which is expressed by Fick's first law. It says that the flux density is proportional to the concentration gradient. Since our model of the star is radially symmetric, Fick's law is mathematically expressed as
$$F = -D\,\frac{\Delta u}{\Delta r}\,, \qquad \text{(T11.4)}$$
where $F$ is the light flux (in units of $\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}}$), $\Delta u$ is a small change of the energy density of black-body radiation (in units of $\mathrm{J\,m^{-3}}$) and $D > 0$ is a constant of proportionality called the diffusion coefficient. The physical meaning of the minus sign is that heat flows from warmer regions (with higher energy density) to colder regions (with lower energy density).

C.1 [13 points] Derive the relation for the energy density of black-body radiation $u$ in terms of the temperature of the body $T$ and basic physical constants. For the energy density of radiation, for simplicity, consider from each source on the surface of the black body only the radial contribution of the given ray. Use the fact that purely radially propagating radiation forms $1/4$ of the total energy radiated by a surface element.
Hint: imagine the volume of energy radiated by a black body in a time $\Delta t$.

Let us further assume that the star has a homogeneous temperature $T_2$ and that outside the star the temperature is $T = 0$ K.

C.2 [7 points] Express the light flux between the core of the star, where $T(0) = T_2$, and its surface, where $T(R) = 0$, in terms of $D$, $T_2$ and basic physical constants.

The diffusion coefficient refers to a particle moving through a medium.

C.3 [10 points] On the basis of dimensional analysis determine the values of $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$, assuming that $D = \frac{1}{3}\lambda^{\alpha}p^{\beta}v^{\gamma}$, where $\lambda$ is the mean free path of the particle (the mean distance the particle travels before it hits another particle), $p$ is its momentum and $v$ its speed.

In a fully ionised star the photons interact mainly with electrons. The effective cross-section for the interaction of an electron and a photon is given by
$$\sigma_e = \frac{8\pi}{3}\left(\frac{\alpha\hbar c}{m_e c^2}\right)^2\,, \qquad \text{(T11.5)}$$
where $m_e$ is the mass of the electron and $\alpha = \frac{e^2}{4\pi\varepsilon_0\hbar c}$. Assume that all the electrons in the star come from the decomposition of hydrogen into its nucleus and electron shell.

C.4 [15 points] Express the diffusion coefficient in terms of $\sigma_e$, the electron density $n_e$ (the number of electrons per unit volume) and basic physical constants.

C.5 [30 points] Express the luminosity of the star only in terms of $M$ and basic physical constants. Evaluate this luminosity for the Sun and compare it with the actual value for the Sun. Determine the coefficient $a$ of equation (T11.1) for this model. To which of the intervals of stellar masses of part A.1 is this model closest?
Note: If you did not manage to determine $T_2$, you may assume $T_2 \propto MR^{-1}$ and on that basis determine the value of the coefficient $a$.
